description: Dry-run the SPF / DKIM / tracking-CNAME checks for a sending domain you own. Stores and binds NOTHING and needs no API key, so you can publish records, check, fix and re-check freely. ⚠️ Each check is TRI-STATE: ok=true means read and correct, ok=false means read and wrong/missing, and ok=null means UNDETERMINABLE (the resolver could not be read) — null is NEVER a pass. The top-level `verified` is true only when all three are true. When a check fails, its `expected` field names the exact record to publish (the DKIM one names <selector>._domainkey.<domain>), so return that to the user rather than a generic error.

dkim_selector.description: The DKIM selector from your provider dashboard — a SINGLE label (default: 'mailo').

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.
